feature: Generates a last from foot geometry
Allowances: toe, fit, sock, heel seat
Parametric last control (length / girth / width / heel)
Morph / deform between base last and foot
Freeform sculpt / surface editing on the last
Pattern flattening (2D pieces from the last)

3DShoemaker: Commercial: $99 personal / $349 business, + Rhino licence; Windows only
Shoemaster: Commercial, on quote; professional seat + training
ICad3D+ / IcadPAN: Commercial; basic package from ~$30, full on quote
Crispin ShoeMaker: Legacy commercial; availability unclear after Autodesk/Delcam changes
PROTIQ Last Configurator: Free web configurator; you pay for the printed last
Gensole: Free for non-commercial makers/researchers; AMF export
Rhino + Grasshopper: Commercial Rhino licence; Grasshopper included; high skill requirement
nTop: Commercial, on quote; steep learning curve
OpenSCAD: Free, open source; code-only, no scan import
Shoefactory.ai: Commercial service; price per pair, limited styles
MeshLab / CloudCompare / Open3D: Free, open source; processing only, no design
PrusaSlicer / Cura / Orca Slicer: Free, open source; print preparation only
